basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a university student currently attending the University of Iowa majoring in Computer Science. I recently moved to Iowa City for school and am originally from a small town in Illinois. I'm interested in technology and gaming, and I love exploring new music, especially from indie and alternative genres. In my free time, I enjoy hiking and trying out new recipes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my studies and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having started my journey in Computer Science at university, I've picked up some programming skills in Python and Java. I often dive into online courses to expand my knowledge outside class, mostly focusing on web development and machine learning.
